summary: The project would store 60 gallons of flammable liquid solvent at a coating shop. California’s HMBP threshold for liquids is 55 gallons, so the proposed 60 gallons exceeds the statewide reporting threshold and likely triggers filing a Hazardous Materials Business Plan with the local CUPA. The facility location/county is missing, so the controlling CUPA and any stricter local requirements cannot be confirmed. The solvent is described as flammable, so it is a hazardous material for this screening unless later facts show a statutory exclusion or below-threshold aggregation issue.
title: California HMBP likely required for 60 gallons of flammable solvent, but CUPA/local location must be identified
